steps.en: Configure the Docker example, then start one local sandbox server
steps.zh: 照 Docker 示例配置后，在本地起一个沙箱服务器

steps.en: Allocates a sandbox from any image and wires in its execution daemon and egress policy
steps.zh: 从任意镜像分配沙箱，接入执行守护进程与出口策略

steps.en: Create the sandbox and run the code your model just wrote, from your app
steps.zh: 在应用代码里创建沙箱、运行模型刚生成的代码

steps.en: Executes inside the isolated container and streams logs and files back; real secrets stay in the vault
steps.zh: 在隔离容器内执行并回传日志与文件，真实密钥留在保险库里

value.en: Untrusted agent code runs safely on your own infra, with the same API from laptop to Kubernetes cluster
value.zh: 不受信的 agent 代码在你自己的基础设施上安全运行，笔记本到集群同一套 API

sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/main/README.md — Getting Started, 'Install and Configure the Sandbox Server' (uvx opensandbox-server init-config ~/.sandbox.toml --example docker; uvx opensandbox-server)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/main/README.md — 'Create a Sandbox and Execute Commands/Scripts' (uv pip install opensandbox; Sandbox.create("alpine"); await sandbox.commands.run("echo 'Hello OpenSandbox!'"); await sandbox.destroy())
